sourceAudit.coverageGap: Public indexing and inventory timing can lag; this is not a representation of exhaustive REO availability.

sourceAudit.summary: Credible public FSBO inventory, York County distressed material, and indexed foreclosure notices were reviewed. A current Court House Avenue FSBO lacks an exact published construction year and property-specific official readback; stale sold FSBOs were rejected.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Distressed notices and FSBO pages are incomplete acquisition evidence, sale rosters can change, and no public search is exhaustive.

sourceAudit.summary: Auction.com, Hubzu, Xome, public builder inventory, and Made It Home inventory were checked. A September foreclosure auction at 326 Finley Square lacked an opening price, interior access, title and lien evidence, financing terms, and a verified private-bath layout, so it was not published as a candidate.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Auction terms, title, redemption, financing, inspection access, and complete public inventory were inadequate; builder claims do not substitute for permit closeout or independent inspection.

sourceAudit.category: User-authorized OneHome / Canopy MLS saved search
sourceAudit.summary: The existing user-authorized OneHome saved-search snapshot was preserved under the token-free import contract. No new authorized snapshot was supplied or requested; public sources were used for today’s discovery and reconciliation.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: The preserved saved-search snapshot is bounded and was not refreshed today. Independent public corroboration remains incomplete for many imported records.

sourceAudit.summary: Third-party listing credentials, broker exports, paid API keys, and direct MLS access were not requested or used.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: This documented public-source coverage limitation is not a failed run.

sourceAudit.category: Current marketing status and transfer chronology
sourceAudit.summary: Known records and new discoveries were reconciled against current public portal, brokerage, listing-history, and transfer evidence. Under-contract states were retained, all known records received a current route and lifecycle observation, and no record reached the second-miss archive threshold.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Second-source status and official transfer chronology remain incomplete for some records; conflicting pages are surfaced rather than silently resolved.

sourceAudit.summary: York County Assessor, One Map, Register of Deeds paths, public parcel fields, and listing transfer histories were audited. Parcel identifiers and transfer chronology were captured where accessible.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Official deed, lien, plat, tax-district, restriction, and rapid-relist readback remain unresolved for multiple candidates, including today’s additions.

sourceAudit.summary: Rock Hill and York County permit, zoning, rental-registration, occupancy, and planning sources were checked. Rock Hill rental registration and safety-inspection rules were confirmed, but no public evidence establishes property-specific separate-room leasing authority.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Property-specific permit closeout, certificates of occupancy, legal bedroom counts, zoning determinations, registration, parking limits, occupant limits, septic capacity, and written room-lease authority remain unresolved.

sourceAudit.summary: FEMA Flood Map Service Center and York County One Map paths were checked. Portal risk labels were treated only as screening prompts, never official property determinations.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Property-specific FEMA or One Map determinations, drainage review, and insurance quotes were not reliably retrievable for every candidate.

sourceAudit.summary: Public listings were reviewed for association presence, dues, and fee conflicts. No controlling declarations, amendments, bylaws, rental rules, resale certificates, budgets, or written management confirmations were publicly obtained.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Whole-unit and individual-room rental authority remain unknown for every condominium or HOA-governed candidate; special assessments and transaction fees remain unknown unless listed.

sourceAudit.summary: Current Apartments.com, Zillow, and RentCafe Rock Hill asks were checked. Published one-bedroom averages near $1,298 to $1,317 support retaining the lower $1,150 private-unit planning benchmark.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: These are asking rents, not executed leases, and may omit concessions, utilities, deposits, parking, and mandatory fees.

sourceAudit.summary: Roomies, SpareRoom, and Furnished Finder were checked. Current private-bath asks commonly span roughly $600 to $1,100, with furnished medium-term asks reaching $1,400; the configured $850 benchmark remains a conservative viability-adjusted input.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: These are asking rents, not executed leases; property-specific demand, utilities, furnishings, parking, bathroom access, insurance, lease length, and legality remain unverified.
